review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares no @[simp] lemmas and no custom simp sets. Its simp use is local: simp only and simp_rw calls inside proofs, which are targeted rewrites with no cycle or competing-rule risk. The only possible issue is that the set-integral measurability lemmas (setLIntegral_kernel_prod_right, setLIntegral_kernel_prod_left and setLIntegral_kernel) lack @[fun_prop] while their non-set siblings have it. That is a fun_prop coverage question, not a simp-interface defect. Those lemmas also take a measurable-set hypothesis that fun_prop would have to discharge. A grep found one downstream use, in WithDensity.lean, which calls the lemma directly, so I found no evidence that the attribute is needed. I did not report it. I could not run Lean, so I made no claims about simplifier behaviour.
